blocked_what: the pre-commit selftest for scripts/merge_drivers.py, at the commit that added both the file and its registration
cause: every worktree runs MAIN's copy of scripts/hooks/pre-commit (.git/hooks/pre-commit resolves against main's worktree), so a SELFTEST_FILES registration made on a branch gates nothing until the branch is merged -- and the hook still prints a selftests timing line, so a small number reads as 'ran, fast' when it means 'ran zero of them'
fix_applied: run the branch copy directly against a deliberately-broken version of the file: python3 scripts/hooks/pre-commit after staging the break. It refused, naming the file
